default_rule: No universal default. The project must name a delivery profile before mastering; if none is named, ask the user which destination the video is for. Within one project/series, use the SAME profile for every episode so dialogue, music and effects stay at the same volume.
note: Loudness is a delivery profile, not a universal constant. The pre-P0 rule 'master everything to -14 LUFS' is retired: -14 LUFS is ONE profile (streaming/social) below, not the default for all destinations. EBU R 128 specifies -23 LUFS for broadcast programme loudness. Re-check platform requirements before a release; do not assume any one target fits every destination.

profiles.destination: Streaming / social platforms (e.g. YouTube, social video)
profiles.source: Common streaming practice; platform specs vary — verify per platform before delivery
